name: Stellar Launch

sources.title: Homepage — daily launch board 'Top Projects Launching Today'; ~2,989 visitors/30 days self-reported; sign-in/up required

Pricing — Free $0 (5 slots/day, up to 180-day scheduling, dofollow only for top-3 daily), Basic $6.49 (guaranteed dofollow, 90-day window), Premium $34.99 (7-day feature + SEO article), Domain Booster $99.99 (reviews across 4-site network)

conditions: Free Launch exists but is queue-limited (5 slots/day, schedule up to 180 days out) and only the top-3 daily-ranked launches earn a dofollow backlink
Paid tiers ($6.49-$99.99) guarantee the dofollow link, earlier dates, featured placement, or a written SEO review
requirements: A shippable product — launches are scheduled to go live at 8:00 AM UTC on the chosen day
Product page details: name, tagline/description, logo, categories (AI, SaaS, Productivity, Marketing Tools, Design Tools are the largest)
preparation: Pick launch method: free queue vs $6.49 guaranteed-dofollow vs higher tiers
If chasing the top-3 dofollow, plan upvote support on launch day
workflow: Complete the project form and select the launch plan/date (free slots book out ~180 days)
Launch goes live 8:00 AM UTC on the scheduled day
Top-3 daily rank → dofollow backlink; otherwise the listing stays as a project page
watchFor: Free queue is very long (up to 180 days out, 5/day) — plan months ahead or pay $6.49
Dofollow on the free tier is conditional on ranking top-3 for the day; vote counts on the board are tiny (0-2 votes typical), so a handful of votes may suffice — still a gamble
'Domain Booster' reviews are written by their team across a 4-site network (direct2app.com, webspot.app, launchpad.ms, stellarlaunch.org) — the same operator runs multiple directories in this catalog
Self-reported traffic is small (~3k visitors/30 days)
Sponsored slots (Direct2App) appear inside ranked lists — paid placement mixes with organic
countsAsLive: A project page exists at stellarlaunch.org/projects/<slug> and the launch appears in the daily board for its scheduled date
unknowns: Exact submission form fields (gated behind sign-in)
Whether non-top-3 free listings get nofollow links or none
Whether scheduling dates beyond 180 days wait for a later window
